about:
Becker/SMC was established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. The company began with a focus on quality electrical products and service to meet customer needs.

Today, Becker/SMC designs and manufactures a range of electrical components including open-type and explosion-proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls, and power distribution equipment. Operating from a 90,000-square-foot facility in Bristol, Virginia, the company has expanded through seven major facility expansions and several acquisitions that added transformers, distribution equipment, vacuum switches, connectors, and electronic monitoring devices. Its Custom Equipment Operation uses parametric engineering and lean manufacturing to turn customer specifications into precision products.

The company serves a variety of industries, with a notable presence in the transit sector following the acquisition of OB Systems, a firm with 20 years of experience supplying electrical substations, rectifiers, AC and DC switchgear, traction power substations, and related hardware to heavy and light rail systems across North America. Its longwall controls also serve mining operations.

Becker/SMC emphasizes that its growth stems from developing major innovations and specialized electrical components in-house, backed by strict quality assurance processes that ensure products meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements.
